title: API Rate Limiter & Redis Caching Investigation
overallGoal: Design a reliable distributed rate limiter in Node.js + Redis without race conditions under burst traffic.
finalOutcome: Delivered a sliding-window Lua script, benchmark comparison, fail-open circuit breaker wrapper, and local fallback strategy.

turns.title: Compare Redis Rate Limit Algorithms
turns.rawUserMessage: Compare token bucket vs sliding window log in Redis for a Node.js API handling ~5k req/s.
turns.intent: Choose the right Redis rate-limiting algorithm for 5k req/s Node.js traffic.
turns.inputSummary: Algorithms: token bucket vs sliding window log; Stack: Node.js + Redis; Load: ~5k req/s.
turns.expectedOutput: Side-by-side comparison table covering accuracy, Redis memory usage, and atomicity tradeoffs.
turns.actualOutput: Delivered comparison table across token bucket, fixed window, and sliding window counter with memory estimates at 5k req/s.
turns.deltaNote: Directly addressed the comparison criteria with concrete numbers.

turns.title: Atomic Sliding Window Lua Script
turns.rawUserMessage: Write the atomic Lua script for sliding window counter and show how to invoke it with ioredis.
turns.intent: Get production-ready atomic Redis Lua code and ioredis integration.
turns.inputSummary: Chosen algorithm: sliding window counter; Client: ioredis.
turns.expectedOutput: Redis Lua script and TypeScript ioredis wrapper function.
turns.actualOutput: Delivered atomic Lua script + typed ioredis wrapper, plus investigation into Redis Cluster hash-slot pinning and clock-skew mitigation.
turns.deltaNote: Expanded during implementation research to cover cluster slot routing and Redis TIME drift.
extras: Added {userId} hash-tag pattern to prevent CROSSSLOT errors in Redis Cluster
Replaced local Node Date.now() with Redis server TIME inside Lua to eliminate multi-pod clock skew

turns.title: Pivot to Fail-Open Degradation Strategy
turns.rawUserMessage: Wait, what happens if Redis goes down for 30 seconds? I do not want legitimate checkout requests blocked.
turns.intent: Prevent Redis outages from blocking checkout requests.
turns.inputSummary: Constraint: 30s Redis outage tolerance; Priority: never block legitimate checkouts.
turns.expectedOutput: Fail-open fallback behavior and circuit breaker strategy.
turns.actualOutput: Pivoted from strict Redis enforcement to a 2-tier circuit-breaker + per-pod LRU token fallback with Prometheus degradation alerts.
turns.deltaNote: Shifted architecture from strict centralized limiting to resilient fail-open fallback based on new availability requirement.
extras: Included half-open probe interval tuning to avoid thundering herd on Redis recovery

turns.title: Unit Test Scenarios Checklist
turns.rawUserMessage: Give me 4 concise integration test cases to verify this before merging.
turns.intent: Obtain a focused pre-merge verification checklist.
turns.inputSummary: Scope: 4 integration test cases for the new limiter + fallback.
turns.actualOutput: Delivered 4 integration test scenarios covering burst boundary, Redis timeout fail-open, cluster hash-tag routing, and recovery.
turns.deltaNote: Matched requested count and scope precisely.
